parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The ID of the asset. If the asset is a Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance, specify the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description: The region ID of the asset.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region in which the instance resides.

>  You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~118703~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the asset. Valid values:

*   **waf**: WAF instance
*   **ga**: Global Accelerator (GA) instance

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddosbgp describe-asset-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name waf_v2_public_cn-lbj382l0000 --type waf --biz-region cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
